model_correction.v11_issue: V11 charged the 15 ms broker budget but omitted the separate 2 ms physical AI completion guard from effective transaction length; the C135 runtime itself already charged both through admission_ai_guard_ms=17.
model_correction.v12_rule: B_eff equals raw AI service bound plus bounded synchronous control plus physical AI completion guard; radio commit guard remains separately deducted from recovery capacity.
model_correction.v12_missing_guard_policy: Every v8 mode must declare ai_completion_guard_ms explicitly; omission is an input error rather than a zero default.

exact_oracle.scope: Finite-state endpoint admission cardinality and schedule consistency; the AI completion guard correction is outside this endpoint-only oracle.

same_event_static_counterfactual.interpretation: Model counterfactual on the same C135 physical events, not a separately measured static-baseline throughput comparison.

preserved_gpu_allocation_validation.reason_not_rerun: V12 changes only the offline envelope charge; C135 runtime and physical admission already used the complete 17 ms guard.

claim_boundary: V12 predicts, and frozen C135 executions realize, one synthetic two-home A100/MPS conditional AI40 class with the full 57 ms admission charge. This is mechanism evidence, not BurstGPT throughput superiority, WCET, production d_MAC, cross-family hardware, restart, durable reconciliation, or exactly-once evidence.
